# Typed SDK Operations

Contract major: `1`. Business operations: 161. Tags are append-only.

## Conventions

| Item | Rule |
|---|---|
| Scope | An operation is a typed contract, not proof that an installed provider implements it |
| Provider duty | Declare the capability and implement the method; unimplemented defaults return Unsupported |
| Host duty | Session cancellation, deadlines, validation, publication fencing |
| Protocol tags | 1 and 6..9 are runtime operations, not business capabilities |
| IDs | Opaque, case-sensitive provider-local strings; never pass CPMediaId values |
| Namespaced playback | resolveVideoResource performs cross-provider validation |
| Times | Milliseconds; absolute times are Unix epoch milliseconds |
| Cursors | Opaque, returned unchanged; PageRequest offsets count items |
| Messages | Newest-first; text is plain text, never a JSON envelope |
| Playlist tags | [] clears the tags, null leaves them unchanged |
| Queue | Empty REPLACE clears the queue |
| Listen | intervalMs is milliseconds; an absent playlist differs from an explicitly empty one |
| Scrobble | playedSeconds is explicitly seconds |
| Comments | CommentQuery preserves opaque cursors; the CommentPageRequest layout is unchanged |
| Albums | Browsing, latest albums and dated charts are separate operations, not aliases |
| Uploads | Opaque account-session handles; no host paths or upload credentials cross the boundary; image and audio chunks are at most 1 MiB |
| Cloud upload | prepareCloudUpload then uploadCloudChunk (whole chunk or fail, exact next offset, complete = last) then completeCloudUpload |
| Provider ownership | Handle ownership, declared size, offset order and final-chunk boundaries |
| Imports | Exactly one of tracks, text or links |
| Reorder | Preserves opaque IDs and sequence; duplicate IDs are invalid, never deduplicated |

See the [field/type reference](SDK_TYPES.md) for every field, nullability and default,
and [provider workflows](WORKFLOWS.md) for domain implementation guidance.
